'''0.14c''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that addressed some slow connectivity issues.

==Changelog==
* Improved stability of the game with bad internet connections (a high percentage of packet loss)

===Bug fixes===
* Fixed bug where a player could not climb through some of the passages
* Fixed an issue where players with a lost connection were considered in match selection
